text:
This mail I received today from Gokul made my day.

He started with zero coding experience.

Today he runs a fully automated NIFTY weekly options bot. AWS EC2 Mumbai. Dhan API. Real time SL monitoring. Exchange SL orders. Telegram notifications on every event.

Designed, built, deployed. All by himself.

This is the shift nobody is talking about loud enough.

For 15 years, the barrier to algo trading was coding. You either learned Python for 2 years, or you paid someone, or subscribe to algo platforms or you stayed manual.

That barrier is gone.

In 2026, if you understand your strategy clearly, AI can write, debug, and deploy it for you. What cannot be outsourced is the thinking. The edge. The discipline. The why behind every rule.

AI did not replace the trader. It removed the excuse. The clarity on systematic trading has to come from experience. The execution can come from Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, whatever. But without understanding why you are entering, sizing, exiting, no AI will save you.

Traders who get this early will have an unfair advantage.
